value.rationale: All-scale nonpositivity is a substantive missing quantifier beyond existing non-CND findings, especially since geodesic Laplace is valid on the projective circle and on spheres. The explicit negative high-degree coefficient supplies a structural harmonic obstruction for a natural manifold covariance kernel and fixes the sharp dimension boundary. It is not a textbook instance of the non-CND iff all-bandwidth equivalence.
